title: Answer
description:
Many sons are being brought to glory. The glory in view is the world to come, not only a mountain or a land.

The captain of their salvation is made perfect through sufferings. He goes through death so the sons can follow.

The One who sanctifies and those who are being sanctified are of one. The Sanctifier has taken flesh and blood with them.

After He has tasted death He calls them brethren. The children given to Him are His, and He is the One who waits on God among them.
